title: Welcome to UNI Labs
sibling_of: lab/film/{svg,script,render,dgst,drafts} — the TRAVELERS assets. This film shares nothing with them and touches none of them.

what_this_file_is.one_line: The ONE truth ledger for the film. Beats only. NO PROSE FOR ANY CUT lives here.
what_this_file_is.the_rule: A beat is a fact, plus its epistemic status, plus its receipt. A cut is a PROJECTION of beats. Narration, captions and on-screen text are authored in a cut file, are derived from beats, and may never introduce a fact this spine does not carry.
what_this_file_is.why_no_prose: Prose is where a claim quietly gains a modifier. TRAVELERS' own QC sheet states `Total scenes 143` while its segment table sums to 157 (lab/film/QC.md) — a hand-typed sentence contradicting its own table. This spine holds no sentence a gate cannot check.
what_this_file_is.why_no_numbers: There is not one numeric literal in any beat. Every number is a `numbers` token resolved at build time by `lab/film/welcome/qc/tokens.cjs`. This estate's governing banner carried six hand-typed numbers that were wrong within six hours and one that was wrong within 176 seconds (CLAUDE.md, 'Corrected AGAIN 2026-07-29'). A banner can be corrected in a day. A film is rendered once and watched for a year.

claim.receipt_must_be: a real path:line, or a command that can be re-executed now
claim.on_screen: rendered plainly; the truth_class governs its material per lib/sp/control_plane/scene.ex

intent.means: what we are trying to do
intent.truth_class: null, always — an intent is not a claim about the world and must never be given one
intent.on_screen: MUST carry the marker INTENT, NOT A MEASURED CLAIM. A cut that renders an intent beat without it is a failing cut.

requires: a working URL or a runnable command
invitation.on_screen: the URL or command is shown verbatim; if it does not work at render time the QC gate fails the cut

quotation.extraction_rule: read the file as utf8, split on /\r?\n/, take lines [a-1 .. b-1] inclusive, join with "\n", sha256 the utf8 bytes. Line endings are normalised on purpose: a CRLF checkout must not change a quotation's identity.
quotation.on_screen: verbatim or not at all. No ellipsis, no tidying, no re-wrapping that changes bytes.

roots.note: Receipts are written `<path>:<line>` when they live in this repository, and `<root>/<path>:<line>` when they do not — `flagellum/…` or `cookbook/…`. The default root is `minecraft`, and its prefix is omitted so that an in-repo receipt is directly stat-able by a gate rooted here. The three roots are named because the estate is three repositories and a film that implies one repository implies a coherence the estate has not got.

how_this_film_uses_them.OBSERVED: a fact read directly off an artifact or off a live process by a re-executable command in the beat's receipt
how_this_film_uses_them.STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTION: structure inferred from artifacts rather than read from one of them
how_this_film_uses_them.REDUCED_MODEL: a statement describing the engine's design as a model of something, not a measurement of it
how_this_film_uses_them.DERIVED: a fact computed by aggregating other measured facts
how_this_film_uses_them.SIMULATED: a fact about a simulated world, never about the world
how_this_film_uses_them.UNKNOWN: somebody looked and could not tell. Renders as fog. Absent is a different state and is refused.

truth_classes.fence: A beat may not carry a truth_class its receipt cannot bear. Nothing in this film is OBSERVED about biology; the only OBSERVED claims here are about this estate's own artifacts and processes.

movements.M0: THE INVITATION — you are looking at a laboratory built to be caught being wrong
movements.M1: THE MISSION — stated in full, unhedged, and marked as INTENT
movements.M2: THE ESTATE — the bodies: a colony, a producer, a flagellar-motor lab, a control plane, a public record
movements.M3: HOW TO WATCH — the surfaces, and what 'live' does and does not mean today
movements.M4: HOW IT WORKS — no reward anywhere; expected free energy; a Markov blanket implemented as a pipe
movements.M5: THE TRUTH MACHINE — truth classes, verdict words, one ledger, and fog
movements.M6: THE HONEST STATE — what is NOT true today. THE LOAD-BEARING MOVEMENT
movements.M7: THE COOKBOOK — the encyclopedia + cookbook corpus and how to take it home
movements.M8: HOW TO ENGAGE — watch, question, FALSIFY, contribute
movements.M9: THE CLOSE — what you would be joining, and what it is honestly worth today

cut_contract.every_cut_is_a_projection: A cut selects beats and orders them. It may drop beats from M0..M5 and M7..M9 freely.
cut_contract.M6_is_not_optional: Every cut MUST cover every fact marked mandatory:true in lab/film/welcome/qc/honest_state.json → facts[]. A cut that shortens M6 is not a shorter film; it is a different claim.
cut_contract.no_new_facts: A cut may not state anything this spine does not carry. If a cut needs a fact, the fact is added here first, with a receipt, and only then rendered.
cut_contract.numbers: A cut renders `numbers` tokens only. A numeric literal in a cut file is a QC failure with no exception.
cut_contract.prohibitions: Beats with register `claim` and `prohibition: true` describe what must NOT appear. They are enforced against the rendered cut, not merely read.
cut_contract.covers_must_resolve: Every string in a beat's  array must exist as an id in qc/honest_state.json → facts[]. The gate refuses a beat that claims to cover a fact that does not exist, and refuses a mandatory fact no beat covers.

What "reasoning" means here (the fence): this is **Class B/C planning** — recursive
  evaluation of expected free energy over future *beliefs* the agent expects to hold.
  It is NOT Class U cognition/understanding. It branches on actions (rolling beliefs
  through the expected transition), not yet on every possible future observation (full
  sophisticated inference is `O((nu·no)^depth)` and is flagged as heavier).

The live Markov blanket in code: a `Port`-owning `GenServer` that connects the
  Elixir active-inference brain to a Node `mineflayer` body over stdio. It lives

defp by_truth_class(%{truth_class: :OBSERVED}), do: :lit_solid
  defp by_truth_class(%{truth_class: :STRUCTURAL_RECONSTRUCTION}), do: :seamed_solid
  defp by_truth_class(%{truth_class: :REDUCED_MODEL}), do: :translucent
  defp by_truth_class(%{truth_class: :DERIVED}), do: :translucent

beats.note: Six classes onto five materials, deliberately: appearance must not determine provenance, so a surface can never infer a truth class back out of a material. This is the estate's answer to the fact that a picture persuades faster than it can be checked. It was dropped from this beat's first draft and the re-hash caught it, which is the quotation rule earning its keep inside the file that defines it.

covers_contract.what: `covers` is an ARRAY OF DECLARED FACT IDS, every one of which must exist in qc/honest_state.json → facts[]. It is machine-checkable. The human-readable phrasing that used to live here is preserved beside it as `covers_prose`, which no gate reads.
covers_contract.why: A coverage field of free prose cannot be checked, and an unchecked coverage field is how a cut comes to drop a fact while still claiming to carry it. The ids are also what the QC gate at qc/verify_welcome_film.cjs reads.
covers_contract.changed: 2026-08-01, during authoring, on discovering that the QC gate being built alongside this file reads `covers` as fact ids. `covers_prose` keeps the original wording so nothing was lost in the conversion.

receipt_contract.receipt: A PURE `<root>/<path>[:<line>[-<line>]]` that a gate can stat, or — where no file can carry the fact — a string beginning `command:` or `url:`. Nothing else. It must never end in prose, because a gate that path-checks receipts will try to stat the sentence.
receipt_contract.receipt_detail: What the receipt shows, and any SECONDARY paths. Prose. Never stat-checked.
receipt_contract.reprove: The re-executable command that recomputes the fact. Present only where one exists.
receipt_contract.changed: 2026-08-01, during authoring. Receipts first carried path, prose and command in one string; the QC gate at qc/verify_welcome_film.cjs stats the whole string and correctly reported four of them as `not on disk`. The gate was right and the format was wrong.
